events.original_text: An empty station platform after dark. The departure board reads: LAST EXPRESS — 21:10.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: Mara runs toward the control desk, still wearing a hospital visitor badge.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: A station clerk looks up as Mara reaches for the red emergency lever.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: Mara pulls the emergency stop. The departing train jolts to a halt.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: The platform alarm sounds over screeching brakes.
events.label: SOUND FX

events.original_text: "You cannot stop the last express!"
events.label: STATION CLERK

events.original_text: Mara pushes a phone toward the clerk. A picture shows a frightened child behind a locked train door.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: "My daughter is on that train. Someone has locked her inside."
events.label: MARA

events.original_text: The clerk zooms into the picture. A carriage number, SIX, is visible beside the child.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: "Carriage six. I can call the driver."
events.label: STATION CLERK

events.original_text: Mara stops his hand before he can lift the radio.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "Read the message first."
events.label: MARA

events.original_text: On the phone: IF YOU CALL THE DRIVER, THE CHILD DIES.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: The station telephone begins to ring.
events.label: SOUND FX

events.original_text: The clerk takes the phone. Mara shakes her head, pleading silently.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "Who is this?"
events.label: STATION CLERK

events.original_text: "You have twenty seconds to let the train leave."
events.label: VOICE ON TELEPHONE

events.original_text: A control-screen countdown falls from twenty to nineteen. A red marker identifies carriage six.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: "There is a child on board. Open the carriage."
events.label: STATION CLERK

events.original_text: The clerk puts the call on speaker so Mara can hear. She grips the desk.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "Please. Let me speak to my daughter."
events.label: MARA

events.original_text: The clerk watches Mara as the voice on the telephone changes to a frightened whisper.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: A sharp breath over the telephone line.
events.label: SOUND FX

events.original_text: "That woman beside you is not her mother."
events.label: VOICE ON TELEPHONE

events.original_text: The clerk slowly turns toward Mara, who is still holding the child's photograph.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: Mara reaches into her coat. The clerk backs away from the desk.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: The countdown keeps ticking.
events.label: SOUND FX

events.original_text: At a different station, courier Niko follows a security officer into a baggage room.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: The officer slams a steel door and points a pistol at Niko.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "Put the case down. Slowly."
events.label: SECURITY OFFICER

events.original_text: Niko lifts a small silver delivery case, his hands shaking.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: "I was paid to deliver it. I do not know what is inside."
events.label: NIKO

events.original_text: The officer removes his own security badge and drops it on the floor.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "Neither does station security."
events.label: SECURITY OFFICER

events.original_text: A red digital display lights up on the case. It begins counting down from thirty seconds.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: "Why is there a timer?"
events.label: NIKO

events.original_text: Niko tries the door handle. It will not move. The officer pockets the key.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "You were never supposed to leave this room."
events.label: SECURITY OFFICER

events.original_text: A train announcement outside the locked room: all passengers please board.
events.label: SOUND FX

events.original_text: Niko stares at the timer, then at a window overlooking a platform full of boarding passengers.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: "Those people. What did you make me carry?"
events.label: NIKO

events.original_text: "The bomb. And your fingerprints are on it."
events.label: SECURITY OFFICER

events.original_text: The officer places a detonator on the table beside the case.
events.label: ACTION

events.original_text: "If you touch that button, everyone on that platform—"
events.label: NIKO

events.original_text: Niko takes a desperate step toward the officer.
events.label: CAMERA

events.original_text: The locked-room countdown continues.
events.label: SOUND FX

promos.hook: She stops the train. Then the caller questions who she is.
promos.cliffhanger: The caller says the woman begging to save the child is not her mother. The clerk has not acted on this warning.
promos.why_it_works: A violent emergency stop grabs attention immediately. A child in a locked carriage and a visible countdown establish the stakes within the cut. The final warning changes how we read the desperate woman without answering whom the clerk should trust.

promos.hook: A courier at gunpoint discovers what he just delivered.
promos.cliffhanger: The courier learns the case is a bomb, he has been framed, and the officer sets a detonator beside it. Will he stop the officer?
promos.why_it_works: The gun and locked door establish danger immediately. A countdown and passengers outside make the stakes visible. The bomb reveal is unresolved, but the proposed out point cuts through Niko's next spoken line; an editor should move it or drop this version.
